name: Cape Town
eyebrow: Mountains, coast & a little city rhythm
headline: Cape Town, between the mountain and the sea
intro: Start with mountain views, follow the coast, and leave time for a long lunch. Cape Town brings a generous mix of natural beauty, neighbourhood discoveries and easy-going moments.
overview: Some journeys ask you to choose between the city and the outdoors. Cape Town lets them sit comfortably together. Build your days around the places that interest you: a coastal drive, a gallery morning, an afternoon in the gardens, or a table with a view. We can help shape the pace around couples, families, friends or a team travelling together.

highlights.title: Follow the coastline
highlights.text: Make a day of the peninsula, with time to stop for the views and choose a few places to explore rather than rushing through every landmark.

highlights.title: A different view of the city
highlights.text: Bring together mountain scenery, waterfront walks and the neighbourhoods that give the city its character. Outdoor plans can stay flexible around the weather.

highlights.title: Taste your way through
highlights.text: Leave space for local cafés, thoughtful dining and an optional Winelands day. The best itinerary has room for a recommendation you discover along the way.

itinerary.title: Arrive & find your bearings
itinerary.text: Settle in, take a gentle waterfront or neighbourhood walk, and enjoy an unhurried first evening. Keep the arrival day light enough to feel like a holiday.

itinerary.title: A day between mountain & sea
itinerary.text: Choose a mountain experience or coastal outing, then balance it with a relaxed lunch and time at your own pace. Keep an alternative ready if conditions change.

itinerary.title: Make it your Cape Town
itinerary.text: Add a peninsula journey, art and food discoveries, a family-friendly outing or a Winelands extension. We can discuss which combination fits your interests and travel dates.

practical.title: Choose your base thoughtfully
practical.text: Tell us whether you prefer lively restaurants nearby, a quieter coastal setting or convenient access for meetings. The right neighbourhood makes a difference to your daily travel.

practical.title: Keep outdoor plans adaptable
practical.text: Mountain and ocean experiences depend on conditions. Allow a little flexibility and discuss alternatives before building a tightly timed itinerary.

practical.title: Balance the travel time
practical.text: Distances, traffic and the number of stops can change the feel of a day. Group experiences by area so the journey has room to breathe.

faqs.question: Can we combine Cape Town with another destination?
faqs.answer: Yes. A Cape Town stay can be discussed alongside a safari, a coastal journey or another destination. We will look at the transfer time, your overall budget and the pace you prefer before suggesting a combination.

faqs.question: Is Cape Town suitable for a corporate retreat?
faqs.answer: It can work well for a blend of meeting time and shared experiences. Tell us your group size, preferred dates, meeting needs and goals so we can discuss suitable arrangements and supplier availability.

faqs.question: Do we need to follow the suggested itinerary?
faqs.answer: No. This is a starting point for a conversation, not a fixed package. We can help shape a different balance of sightseeing, dining, family time and independent exploring.

name: Kariba
headline: Slow days on Lake Kariba
intro: Golden light on the water, long conversations and a horizon that seems to stretch a little further. Kariba is an invitation to slow down and enjoy being somewhere different.
overview: A Kariba journey is less about a packed schedule and more about the feeling of time well spent. Think quiet mornings, time on the water and evenings made for sharing a meal. Whether you imagine a lakeside stay or would like to explore the possibility of a houseboat experience, we can discuss the kind of setting and arrangements that suit your group.

highlights.title: Days shaped by the water
highlights.text: Discuss lake outings and time to simply enjoy the view. Activities and vessel arrangements should be chosen around your group, comfort and available operators.

highlights.title: A stay that brings people together
highlights.text: Kariba lends itself to shared meals, family catch-ups and time away with friends. Let the size of the group and the style of the trip guide your accommodation choices.

highlights.title: The quieter kind of escape
highlights.text: Read, rest, take photographs or watch the changing light. Leave a few spaces in the plan for the simple pleasure of not having to be anywhere else.

itinerary.title: Trade the rush for a lake view
itinerary.text: Arrive, settle into your chosen setting and take time to get comfortable. A relaxed first meal and an early evening let everyone ease into the pace.

itinerary.title: Make time for the water
itinerary.text: Build a day around an optional lake experience, subject to suitable arrangements and conditions. Keep time free afterwards to rest, reconnect and enjoy your surroundings.

itinerary.title: One more slow morning
itinerary.text: Take breakfast without watching the clock, then leave enough time for the return journey. Extend your stay if the group would rather have another full day than a short escape.

practical.title: Decide on the style of stay
practical.text: A lakeside property and a houseboat offer different experiences. Share your expectations for space, facilities, privacy and time on the water before comparing options.

practical.title: Discuss the full journey
practical.text: Your starting city and preferred way of travelling shape the plan. Include transfers and travel days in the brief, rather than considering only the nights at the destination.

practical.title: Plan activities with care
practical.text: Water-based activities depend on operator arrangements and conditions. Confirm safety provisions, inclusions and suitability for your party before accepting a quotation.

faqs.question: Can you help us explore a houseboat trip?
faqs.answer: Tell us your dates, group size, preferred number of nights and the facilities that matter to you. We can discuss the enquiry and available supplier options; a particular vessel or departure is only confirmed through the agreed booking process.

faqs.question: Would Kariba suit a team getaway?
faqs.answer: It is worth considering for a group that values time together and a change of pace. If you also need structured meetings, reliable connectivity or particular facilities, include these in your corporate travel brief.

faqs.question: Can the trip be built around a celebration?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can include a birthday, anniversary or group occasion in your enquiry. Share the size of your party and what you have in mind so that any special requests can be discussed with the relevant suppliers.

name: Victoria Falls
eyebrow: A little wonder goes a long way
headline: See Victoria Falls at your own pace
intro: The sound of the water, the mist in the air and the sense of standing somewhere extraordinary. Pair the Falls with river time, comfortable evenings and experiences chosen around you.
overview: Victoria Falls can be a short journey with a big sense of occasion, or the opening chapter of a longer Southern African holiday. Keep the Falls at the heart of the trip, then choose what belongs around them: an easy-going river experience, a special meal, a little adventure or time to do very little. We help you turn that mix into a considered travel brief.

highlights.title: An unforgettable natural setting
highlights.text: Allow time to experience the Falls rather than treating them as a quick stop. Viewing conditions change, so the journey should be planned around your dates and interests.

highlights.title: Take the longer view
highlights.text: Explore the idea of a river outing or a relaxed afternoon with a view. A slower experience can be the perfect balance to an activity-filled morning.

highlights.title: Choose your own level of adventure
highlights.text: From sightseeing to more active pursuits, discuss the experiences you are comfortable with. Suitability, operating conditions and supplier terms matter as much as the excitement.

itinerary.title: Arrive somewhere extraordinary
itinerary.text: Settle into your accommodation and get a feel for the town. Keep the first evening simple, with time to relax before your first full day.

itinerary.title: A day for the Falls
itinerary.text: Make the Falls your main experience, with space afterwards for a long lunch and some rest. Add another activity only if it suits the rhythm of your trip.

itinerary.title: River light & a final memory
itinerary.text: Consider an optional river experience or a quieter day together before departure. For a longer journey, discuss a safari or another regional destination as the next chapter.

practical.title: Start with your travel dates
practical.text: The look and feel of the Falls can change with water levels and conditions. Share what you most want to experience so the planning conversation can reflect your timing.

practical.title: Clarify each activity
practical.text: Ask what is included, how transfers work and what conditions apply to the experiences you select. Keep optional activities separate from the core stay until they are confirmed.

practical.title: Give connections some space
practical.text: Allow comfortable transfer and departure windows, particularly when combining destinations. A little breathing room makes a short trip feel much more relaxed.

faqs.question: How many nights should we consider?
faqs.answer: Three or four nights can be a useful starting point for a conversation about the Falls and a few selected experiences. The right duration depends on your arrival times, interests and whether you want to combine the stay with another destination.

faqs.question: Can we visit as a family or a group?
faqs.answer: Yes, share the group size, age range and preferred pace when you enquire. We can discuss suitable stay options and activity requests, with individual supplier conditions confirmed before booking.

faqs.question: Can we combine Victoria Falls with a safari?
faqs.answer: You can ask about a combined journey. We will consider your available days, route and transfer preferences before discussing options; no safari or transport arrangement is included simply by selecting the destination.

name: Zanzibar
eyebrow: Island days with a story to tell
headline: Zanzibar, from Stone Town to the shore
intro: Wander through Stone Town, pause over something delicious, then give yourself over to island time. Zanzibar brings a sense of discovery to a beach escape.
overview: A good island holiday can be more than time by the pool. Zanzibar offers the chance to pair a coastal stay with a glimpse of the island’s character, from Stone Town’s lanes to the flavours and details you notice along the way. Choose a quiet reset, a couple’s escape or a mix of exploring and unwinding, with a plan that leaves room for both.

highlights.title: Find your stretch of coast
highlights.text: Different coastal settings suit different holidays. Tell us whether you imagine quiet mornings, lively surroundings or a resort stay where most of your time is spent on site.

highlights.title: A chapter in Stone Town
highlights.text: Make space for a considered visit to Stone Town, with time to walk, look and pause. A guided experience can help bring more context to what you see.

highlights.title: Enjoy the in-between moments
highlights.text: A long breakfast, a swim or a table by the water can be as memorable as an excursion. Keep the itinerary light enough to enjoy where you are staying.

itinerary.title: Ease into island time
itinerary.text: Arrive, transfer to your chosen base and settle in. Keep the first day free of ambitious plans so the holiday starts gently.

itinerary.title: Explore a little deeper
itinerary.text: Set aside a day for Stone Town or another carefully chosen outing. Discuss the experience and transfer time in advance, then leave the evening open.

itinerary.title: Stay for the sea
itinerary.text: Spend the remaining days at your preferred pace, with optional water activities or a special meal if you wish. Balance every outing with time simply to be on the island.

practical.title: Choose the setting, not just the room
practical.text: Your beach location affects the rhythm of your stay and the journeys to outings. Include your priorities for swimming, atmosphere and activities in the brief.

practical.title: Consider tides & activity conditions
practical.text: Coastal and water experiences vary with conditions. Confirm the details of any planned boat trip or activity with the operator before finalising your arrangements.

practical.title: Travel with cultural awareness
practical.text: A resort day and a visit to town are different experiences. Ask about appropriate clothing and local expectations when planning time beyond the beach.

faqs.question: Can we combine a beach stay with Stone Town?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask about a split stay or a visit from your coastal base. The best arrangement depends on your flight times, number of nights and how much exploring you would like to do.

faqs.question: Is this a fixed beach package?
faqs.answer: No. The ideas on this page are inspiration for a tailored enquiry. Accommodation, meals, transfers and optional activities should be set out clearly in the quotation you choose to accept.

faqs.question: Can Zanzibar be part of a longer trip?
faqs.answer: You can discuss combining the island with another destination. Share the length of your holiday and your starting point so the route can be considered as a whole.

name: Mauritius
eyebrow: The art of taking a proper break
headline: Make time for Mauritius
intro: Gentle mornings, a beautiful coastal setting and days that need very little explanation. Mauritius is a place to settle in, reconnect and enjoy a holiday at your own pace.
overview: The right Mauritius stay starts with how you want to feel while you are away. Perhaps it is the ease of a resort with thoughtful facilities, a quieter escape for two or a family holiday with room for everyone. Choose a comfortable base, add a few experiences that interest you, and leave plenty of time for the island to work its magic.

highlights.title: A base that fits your holiday
highlights.text: Look beyond the room photograph to the setting, meal arrangements and facilities. A well-matched stay can make the simplest days the best ones.

highlights.title: A little more than the beach
highlights.text: Balance time by the water with a selected inland outing, a local food experience or a scenic drive. You do not need a busy itinerary to see another side of the island.

highlights.title: Time together, comfortably
highlights.text: For couples, families and groups, the details matter: room configurations, shared meals and enough flexibility for different interests. Start with what makes the holiday work for your people.

itinerary.title: Arrive & exhale
itinerary.text: Transfer to your chosen stay and take the first afternoon as it comes. Find the view, enjoy a meal and let the holiday begin without a schedule.

itinerary.title: Discover beyond your base
itinerary.text: Choose one outing that adds something to your trip, whether that means scenery, food or a little exploring. Keep the following day light.

itinerary.title: More of what you came for
itinerary.text: Return to the pool, the beach, a favourite table or an optional activity. Leave with the sense that you had time to enjoy the place rather than simply pass through it.

practical.title: Match the stay to your priorities
practical.text: Tell us about your group, meal preferences, preferred atmosphere and must-have facilities. These details are more useful than choosing only by a star rating.

practical.title: Understand the inclusions
practical.text: Meals, drinks, transfers and activities can be arranged in different ways. Compare the full quotation and supplier terms so you know what your holiday covers.

practical.title: Keep room for the weather
practical.text: Outdoor and water-based plans depend on conditions. Discuss your travel dates and any priority experiences before setting the final itinerary.

faqs.question: Can you help us choose between different styles of stay?
faqs.answer: Share whether you prefer a quiet couple’s escape, family facilities or a setting for friends travelling together. We can use your priorities to discuss suitable options rather than offering a one-size-fits-all holiday.

faqs.question: Can we request a honeymoon or anniversary trip?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include the occasion, dates and the touches that matter to you in your enquiry. Any special arrangements or property benefits depend on the supplier’s offer and must be confirmed in writing.

faqs.question: Do we need to book activities before travelling?
faqs.answer: Discuss any experience that is essential to your trip early in the planning process. Other outings can remain optional, depending on availability and the flexibility you prefer.

name: Dubai
eyebrow: A city break with another dimension
headline: See another side of Dubai
intro: A striking city, a quieter desert landscape and plenty of ways to make a few days your own. Discover Dubai through the experiences that interest you, from culture and dining to time by the coast.
overview: Dubai can be a focused city escape, an extended stopover or the setting for a business journey with a little leisure built in. The key is choosing well: where to stay, which experiences deserve your time and how much to fit into each day. We can help bring those choices together around a clear brief and a comfortable pace.

highlights.title: The city, your way
highlights.text: Choose a mix of architecture, galleries, shopping or dining rather than trying to see everything. Group nearby experiences to keep more time for enjoying them.

highlights.title: A different kind of horizon
highlights.text: Consider a desert experience as a change of scene. Discuss comfort, activity level and the operator’s arrangements before deciding what suits your party.

highlights.title: Work with a little room around it
highlights.text: A business trip need not end at the meeting-room door. Add a free afternoon, a shared dinner or a short leisure extension around the work that brings you there.

itinerary.title: Settle into the city
itinerary.text: Choose a base that makes sense for your main plans, then spend the first evening close by. A simple arrival day is especially useful after a long flight.

itinerary.title: Two sides of Dubai
itinerary.text: Plan a city-focused day with time for a more traditional neighbourhood or a cultural stop alongside the contemporary skyline. Keep transfers realistic.

itinerary.title: Choose your final chapter
itinerary.text: Add a desert outing, a coastal day or time for the interests you have not yet explored. For business travellers, build the leisure time around the confirmed work schedule.

practical.title: Location makes a difference
practical.text: Business districts, beaches and major attractions need not be close to one another. Choose your base around the places you expect to spend the most time.

practical.title: Share your occasion
practical.text: A family holiday, stopover and corporate event have different priorities. Include the purpose of your visit so the plan reflects the trip you are actually taking.

practical.title: Plan considerate outings
practical.text: Ask about local expectations and the practical details of each activity. Build outdoor plans around the conditions expected during your stay.

faqs.question: Can you plan around a conference or business event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include the venue, event dates, attendee count and any fixed commitments in your corporate brief. Accommodation, transfers, meetings and leisure requests can then be discussed as one coordinated enquiry.

faqs.question: Can we add a short Dubai stay to another journey?
faqs.answer: You can ask about a stopover or multi-destination trip. The options depend on your route, travel dates and preferred time in the city, with flight and accommodation arrangements confirmed through the quotation process.

faqs.question: Can visa assistance be discussed separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Let us know your nationality, current country of residence and travel purpose through the international visa enquiry. Entry requirements and the assistance available need to be considered for your circumstances.

name: Bali
headline: Explore Bali at your own pace
intro: Green inland landscapes, moments of reflection and time beside the sea. Build a Bali journey that gives each place the attention it deserves, rather than moving on too soon.
overview: Bali invites a more considered kind of itinerary. You might spend part of the journey inland, with time for food, art and a change of scenery, then finish with days by the coast. Or choose one comfortable base and explore from there. Start with your interests and your preferred pace, and let those guide the shape of the trip.

highlights.title: A greener change of scene
highlights.text: Make time for inland landscapes and the small details of daily life. Choose a few meaningful outings instead of fitting a different stop into every hour.

highlights.title: A coast that suits your pace
highlights.text: Different coastal areas offer different atmospheres. Share whether you want quiet, dining and social energy, or a stay where you can comfortably do very little.

highlights.title: Travel with curiosity
highlights.text: Local art, food and cultural experiences can give the journey more depth. Approach sacred places and community spaces with care and follow local guidance.

itinerary.title: Arrive without the rush
itinerary.text: Allow time to recover from the journey and settle into your first base. Keep your arrival day simple, particularly if another transfer follows the flight.

itinerary.title: A few days of discovery
itinerary.text: Spend a chapter inland or exploring from your chosen stay. Mix a planned outing with a slower day so the experience does not become a sequence of transfers.

itinerary.title: Finish at your own pace
itinerary.text: Close the trip with coastal time, good food and space for whatever you enjoyed most. If you prefer a single base, use these days for a gentler rhythm rather than another move.

practical.title: Allow for the journey between places
practical.text: Travel times can influence how much you enjoy a multi-stop stay. Discuss transfers and avoid changing accommodation so frequently that the holiday feels like packing.

practical.title: Choose atmosphere carefully
practical.text: A lively dining area and a quiet retreat create very different experiences. Tell us how you imagine your evenings as well as your daytime plans.

practical.title: Leave space for local guidance
practical.text: Cultural visits and outdoor activities have their own practical expectations. Ask about clothing, access and operator requirements before setting out.

faqs.question: Should we stay in one place or split the trip?
faqs.answer: A split stay can offer different settings, while one base can make a holiday feel more relaxed. The better choice depends on your number of nights, interests and willingness to spend time transferring between areas.

faqs.question: Can we request a wellness-focused journey?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share the kind of experience you have in mind, such as quiet surroundings, gentle activities or time for rest. We can discuss relevant travel arrangements without making health or therapeutic claims.

faqs.question: Can the trip be tailored for a couple or a small group?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include your group size, room preferences and shared interests in the enquiry. The suggested journey is a starting point and can be reshaped around the people travelling.

name: Kruger & surrounds
eyebrow: Take a walk on the quieter side
headline: Plan your Kruger safari
intro: Early light, the anticipation of a game drive and evenings shaped by the sounds around you. Explore a safari journey that balances discovery with the simple pleasure of being in the bush.
overview: A memorable safari is not a list of sightings to complete. It is the patience of looking, the knowledge of a good guide and the quiet moments between discoveries. Discuss the setting and style of stay that suit you, from a focused safari break to a bush-and-city combination, with clear arrangements for accommodation, activities and transfers.

highlights.title: Make space for the unexpected
highlights.text: Wildlife experiences are shaped by nature, not a timetable. Enjoy the landscape and the learning along the way without treating any particular sighting as a promise.

highlights.title: Choose your safari style
highlights.text: Different accommodation and guiding arrangements create different journeys. Tell us your comfort preferences, group needs and the kind of experience you imagine.

highlights.title: Enjoy the hours between outings
highlights.text: A restful base matters as much as the time exploring. Leave space for a book, a meal and a little stillness before the next experience.

itinerary.title: Arrive in a different rhythm
itinerary.text: Travel to your chosen base and settle in. Any first-day activity should fit your arrival time and the arrangements confirmed by your host or operator.

itinerary.title: Look, listen & discover
itinerary.text: Build a full day around the activities included in your selected stay, with time to rest between them. Let the experience unfold rather than filling every gap.

itinerary.title: Keep the journey connected
itinerary.text: Enjoy a final unhurried morning before departure. If you are combining safari with Cape Town or another stop, allow realistic time for onward travel.

practical.title: Be precise about the setting
practical.text: Kruger and surrounding safari areas include different properties and experiences. A quotation should identify where you will stay and what activities are included.

practical.title: Discuss suitability early
practical.text: Share the ages in your group, mobility considerations and any practical requirements privately with the team. Activities and properties may have their own participation conditions.

practical.title: Review the complete arrangement
practical.text: Transfers, meals, guiding, conservation-related charges and optional activities can vary. Confirm the inclusions and ask an appropriate healthcare professional about destination-related health preparation.

faqs.question: Are wildlife sightings guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Wildlife is unpredictable, and no individual animal or sighting should be treated as guaranteed. The value of a safari also comes from the landscape, guiding and time spent observing the natural environment.

faqs.question: Can we combine safari with Cape Town?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enquire about a combined journey. Share your available dates and preferred pace so accommodation and travel between the destinations can be considered together.

faqs.question: Can a safari suit a family or corporate group?
faqs.answer: It may, depending on the property, activities and needs of the group. Include the age range, group size and any meeting requirements in your brief so suitability can be discussed before making arrangements.
